name: strong_legs
description: Hip, knee and ankle motors 10 times stronger: 10 times the force limit and 10 times the stiffness
notes: Both numbers go up together: with stiffness 20 a motor only reaches a 40 force limit 2 radians off its target, so a higher limit alone would barely change how hard the legs push. Neck and toes stay standard. Checked stable on 2026-10-31 (no simulation warnings with random commands); Duck 3.1's brain falls in it 10 of 10 times on flat ground because its small commands now kick hard.
